lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular spots is visible across the mid-lateral flank, arranged in approximately five to six discernible horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Prominent vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal spot rows, creating a defined grid-like pattern of anchor nodes across the central flank region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical intensity gradient with light highlights on the dorsal edge and deep shadows on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of an elongated, light-colored object, consistent with an attached remora, oriented horizontally just posterior to the fifth gill slit.
